10 recommended bear removal clinics in Osaka! Compare by price, treatment method, and area

"I'm concerned about the dark circles under my eyes, but I don't know what type of dark circles I have."

"There are so many clinics in Osaka that I can't decide which one to choose."

As mentioned above, there may be many people who are positively considering treatment but are unsure about choosing a clinic.

Dark circles are explained by the appearance of black, blue, or brown, but the shadows created by the puffiness and hollows under the eyes are also involved, and the causes may overlap.

Treatment methods vary depending on the cause, such as protrusion of orbital fat, thin skin, pigmentation, and depression, so it is important not to choose a treatment based solely on your own judgment.

In this article, for those considering bear removal in Osaka, we will compare and explain 10 selected bear removal clinics in the Osaka area, centered on Umeda and Shinsaibashi, in terms of price, procedure, and access, based on the selection of treatments by bear type.

In addition, we have summarized the progress of downtime, how to deal with the risk of failure, and things to check before counseling.

Surgical method, fees, doctor's experience and track recordNarrowing down clinics based on these three points is the key to comparing and considering bear removal in Osaka.

What you can learn from this article
  • There are four types of dark circles under the eyes: black, blue, brown, and shadow, and the treatment suitable for each type is different.

The appropriate treatment for dark circles under the eyes varies depending on the type.

Accurately determining the type of bear you have is the first step in choosing a treatment.

black, blue, brown, shadowThere are different factors that contribute to the appearance of vision, and sometimes multiple causes overlap.

Causes of 4 types of dark circles and appropriate treatments
  • Black bears: Transconjunctival degreasing is likely to be indicated due to swelling of orbital fat.
  • Blue dark circles: Caused by transparent blood vessels, lifestyle adjustments and medical examinations are important.
  • Brown dark circles: Check the cause of pigmentation and consider treatment if necessary
  • Shadow dark circles: Caused by dimples and can be improved with fat injection or hyaluronic acid injection

If you undergo a treatment that is not suitable for your bear type, not only will you not see any improvement despite spending money and time, but you will also end up taking extra risks.

The basics of self-checking are looking in the mirror in a bright place.Gently pull the skin under the eyesThat's it.

Changes in color and shadow when the skin is pulled are helpful, but it is not possible to determine the cause of dark circles or the suitability of treatment based on appearance alone.

However, there are cases where multiple types coexist, and it is difficult to determine by self-examination alone.

Check with your doctor during your consultation to get an accurate idea of your bear type.

The appearance of shadows changes depending on the lighting angle, so it will be easier to seek advice if you observe the symptoms you are concerned about in multiple situations.

Black bears are easily indicated for transconjunctival degreasing due to fat bulges and shadows.

The main cause of dark circles is the accumulation under the eyes.orbital fatThis is the bulge caused by pushing up the skin and the shadow that forms underneath.

As we age, the ligaments that support the orbital fat loosen and the fat protrudes forward, creating a three-dimensional step under the eyes.

Because this step creates a shadow, no improvement can be expected with skin care or whitening treatments.

How to self-check for black bears
  • Dark circles become lighter when looking up in a bright place
  • There are three-dimensional puffiness/steps under the eyes
  • No improvement with skin care or whitening treatments
  • Even if you pull the skin, the bulge is noticeable instead of the color.

For a fundamental solution, remove fat from the conjunctival side (behind the eyelids)Transconjunctival degreasingis valid.

It is unique in that it does not leave any external scars because it can be performed without cutting the skin.

If depressions remain after degreasing, a method of adjusting the difference by combining fat injection, in which the removed fat is injected under the eyes, or hyaluronic acid injection, is selected.

Excessive removal of orbital fat risks creating sunken skin. Please check the experience and technical ability of your doctor before undergoing treatment.

To tell if it's a black bear, look to see if it fades when you look up in bright light.

Blue bears are related to thin skin and transparent blood vessels, so it is necessary to take measures according to the cause.

Blue circles are caused by the thin skin under the eyes, which allows the blue blood vessels to show through.

Lifestyle factors such as lack of sleep may be a contributing factor, but if the cause is thin skin itself, there are limits to self-care alone.

What is Blue Bear?

A condition in which the skin under the eyes is thin and the blue blood vessels can be seen through.

This type is easily worsened by cold weather and lack of sleep, and is easily affected by lifestyle habits.

Because injection treatment can have complications, the necessity and suitability of the treatment will be determined by the doctor.

At the clinic, a doctor will examine the thinness of your skin, the degree of transparency of your blood vessels, and the presence of depressions, and consider treatment options.

Fat injection may be an option, but there are risks such as lumps and left-right discrepancies, and its effectiveness is limited depending on the cause of the blueness.

The effects of hyaluronic acid injections vary depending on absorption, and there is a possibility of serious complications such as blood vessel occlusion and visual impairment, so please consult your doctor carefully.

Do not rub or massage your eyes vigorously, and if the discoloration persists, consult your doctor.

Brown dark circles are related to pigmentation, so consider external treatments depending on the cause.

UV damage and friction (such as the habit of rubbing your eyes) often cause pigmentation, and if irritation or inflammation continues, it may appear darker.

Unlike other types of dark circles, it is not a structural problem of the skin but a pigment problem, so laser treatment and care using whitening ingredients are the main options.

The doctor will decide whether to use laser or other methods based on the type of pigmentation and the safety of the area around the eyes.

Topical drugs such as hydroquinone and tretinoin may cause irritation, so use them as directed by your doctor.

However, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation may occur after laser irradiation, and post-procedure care should follow your doctor's instructions.

After laser treatment for brown dark circles, be sure to use sunscreen and avoid UV rays. If you neglect post-procedure care, there is a risk of worsening pigmentation.

Shadow bears are caused by depressions and can be improved with fat injection or hyaluronic acid injection.

Shadow circles occur when light does not reach the hollows under the eyes, creating shadows.

The main causes are a decrease in fat and tissue due to aging, and a condition in which the area under the eyes becomes sunken due to the original bone structure.

Since it is not a pigment problem, no improvement can be expected with whitening treatments or lasers.

Comparison of hyaluronic acid injection and fat injection
  • Hyaluronic acid injection:Duration of effect varies from person to person - Risk of blood vessel occlusion and visual impairment
  • fat injection:Uses own fat, individual differences in amount of fixation, risk of lumps, etc.

The purpose of the treatment is to fill in the dents and eliminate the level difference.Hyaluronic acid injection or fat injectionone of them will be selected.

The volume of hyaluronic acid injection changes after injection, but the duration of the effect varies from person to person and depends on the formulation.

Fat injection uses your own tissue, but the amount of fixation varies from person to person, and you need to be careful about risks such as lumps and infection.

Hyaluronic acid injection may be an option for shadow bears, but it has serious side effects such as blood vessel occlusion and visual impairment, so the suitability of this treatment must be carefully determined.

For a self-check, see if your dark circles fade when you look up or shine a bright light on your face.
